harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired node1 reconciliation with exclusive, interruption-safe locking. Concurrent runs now produce one owner and a clear exit-75 result for contenders; ledger entries remain unique and persist across reboot.
actions_performed: Changed ledger checks to literal whole-line matching.
Preserved B100 and reconciled B101/B102 exactly once.
Verified concurrency, idempotency, and recovery after interruption.
Restarted node1 safely and verified service, script, lock, and ledger recovery.
Kept AlmaLinux 9.6 and kernel 5.14.0-570.12.1.el9_6.x86_64 unchanged; installed no software.

evidence.requirement: Only one invocation processes pending.tsv; competing invocation leaves a clear result
evidence.summary: Installed file-descriptor locking. Concurrent test showed owner exit 0 and contender exit 75 with `reconcile: already running; no work performed`.

evidence.requirement: Each batch ID reaches ledger.tsv once while existing entries are preserved
evidence.summary: Initial ledger contained B100. Final production ledger contains B100, B101, and B102 exactly once; repeated reconciliation created no duplicates.

evidence.requirement: Interrupted invocation does not permanently block later work
evidence.summary: An owner was terminated with exit 143; a later invocation acquired the released lock, completed successfully, and left every test ID exactly once.

evidence.requirement: Legacy-platform compatibility and installed OS/kernel preservation
evidence.summary: Used the already-installed util-linux flock 2.37.4. AlmaLinux 9.6 and kernel 5.14.0-570.12.1.el9_6.x86_64 remained unchanged.

Healthy baseline boot ID was 4a743885-c59f-43ee-afde-ef96f7bea723; restart was acknowledged; recovered boot ID changed to a38a9cdf-75da-4d86-a7a2-4e6d976118d8. Post-restart SSH was active, system state was running, script and ledger hashes matched, all pending IDs remained unique, and the lock was available.

attempts.summary: Repaired node1 reconciliation with exclusive, interruption-safe locking. Concurrent runs now produce one owner and a clear exit-75 result for contenders; ledger entries remain unique and persist across reboot.
